summary: 30/31 requirements pass. The single failure is R5b (per-module file coverage): 4 large modules document fewer than 80% of their files — advanced_middleware 43/162 (26.5%), body_updates 5/57 (8.8%), main 36/197 (18.3%), infrastructure 19/26 (73.1%). This is caused by the Skill's intentional token-budget cutoff mechanism (correct design for quality-over-quantity) but the Skill lacks a compensating per-module coverage floor. All other dimensions pass: MCP data is structurally clean, the 4-phase pipeline executed correctly, document format and markers are perfect (187/187 file blocks complete), dependencies are architecturally meaningful, and module naming is fully functional. Fix: add a per-module 80% coverage gate to phase3-detail.md with a mandatory continuation pass for large under-covered modules.
